items.title: BF1 lining to 100%
items.description: Complete Blast Furnace #1 lining to full specification so commissioning can proceed without refractory risk. Aligns with W1: Finish lining to 100% (0–14 days).
items.impact: Reduces commissioning downtime risk; prerequisite for stable heat and repeatable taps.

items.title: Gate G1: stable heat (7-day no-shutdown streak)
items.description: Achieve 7 consecutive days without unplanned shutdown and a predictable tap rhythm (Gate G1).
items.impact: Enables credible production disclosures and steadier billet runs.

items.title: Gate G2: BL1 repeatability (3 consecutive merchant runs)
items.description: Deliver 3 consecutive BL1 runs meeting minimum section + slag/inclusion tolerance for merchant billet (Gate G2).
items.impact: Unlocks regular external sales cadence and bond pricing confidence.

items.title: Gate G3: 30-day cost-control baseline recorded
items.description: Record 30 days of Fuel+Labor per ton plus scrap/rework rate and unplanned downtime days (Gate G3). Track: billets_shipped_last_30d, fuel_cost_last_30d, wages_last_30d, scrap_rework_rate, unplanned_downtime_days.
items.impact: Creates first defensible profitability baseline and supports capacity/expansion decisions.

items.title: Gate G4: USS-1 listed and first secondary trade cleared on AX
items.description: Complete USS-1 disclosure, price + allocate (Sabine lead), list on AX, and clear first secondary trade/settlement (Gate G4).
items.impact: Unlocks capex acceleration and a working-capital buffer to stabilize 80%+ Line 1 operations.

items.title: Water Phase 3 complete and certified
items.description: Complete construction, commissioning, and certification of Water Phase 3 (target: ~800 households, remaining half-city). Phase 3 construction started ~4 weeks before 590 BCE-07-18 (~590 BCE-06-20).
items.impact: Expands reliable potable water coverage to the remaining half of the city; reduces public health load and supports housing/industry growth.
notes: Construction progressing; no inspection setbacks this week.
